items.reason: The passive setup contains the relative modifier “摸过保罗的” modifying “手帕和围裙” before the main question “病人随后怎么样了？”. The referent “病人” is clear, but this embeds a relative description inside a passive setup before the question.
“是谁……的” frames a single 把-construction asking for its actor; there are no embedded clauses. “书” and “屋里” have clear contextual referents.

The passive setup “Cloths that had touched Paul were taken to the sick” embeds the relative clause “that had touched Paul” before the main question. “The sick” has a clear referent, but the relative-inside-passive setup creates the specified wording burden.
